title: add-local-authoring-cli-and-playground-docs
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: Make it fast for developers to prototype RAG-based agents locally and iterate on tool schemas and evals before committing to the cloud. This PR introduces a small local-first authoring CLI (redwood-rag author) plus an opinionated in-browser 'playground' docs page that loads a serialized agent bundle to let designers try tool-calls, tweak prompts, and run embedded evals. The authoring CLI produces a portable agent bundle (manifest.json + tool adapters + prompt templates) and includes a lightweight dev evaluator that runs a set of example prompts against a local mock model or a configured Redwood hosted model. What changed: 1) tools/authoring/cli: new tiny CLI (Rust -> compiled binary) that scaffolds agent bundles, validates tool schemas, and runs local eval suites. 2) examples/rag-samples/authoring-templates: three starter templates (qa-retrieval, multistep-form, ticket-triage) with sample tool adapters and a small dataset for local retrieval. 3) docs/playground: new interactive page and config that loads agent bundles from local filesystem or a provided URL; includes "record session" feature and export to bundle. 4) tests/authoring: unit tests for manifest validation and two integration smoke tests that exercise the dev evaluator against the mock model. 5) examples/scripts/dev-load.sh: convenience script to start the playground and serve bundles locally. Checklist: - [x] CLI binary + README, usage examples - [x] Manifest schema bump (backwards compatible) and validator - [x] Playground docs + static assets - [x] Example templates and minimal dataset - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] Changelog/release notes entry How to validate locally: 1) ./redwood-rag author init --template=qa-retrieval 2) ./redwood-rag author bundle ./my-agent --out=./dist/agent-bundle.zip 3) scripts/dev-load.sh ./dist/agent-bundle.zip 4) open http://localhost:9001/playground and choose "Load local bundle" Testing notes: CI initially failed on a lint rule for CLI argument names (arg casing). I updated the CLI to accept both kebab-case and snake_case equivalents and added tests. The integration suite uses a deterministic mock model so results are stable. Backwards compatibility: manifest schema version incremented to 1.1.0 but validator accepts 1.0.x bundles (no breaking changes to tool adapter API). Related: references ENG-9274 for dev tools uplift and DES-418 for playground UX scope. Release note: adds dev-only tooling and docs; no runtime breaking change.
